thread:
ashley: Heads-up — PR #528 landed a draft of the backpressure handbook in /docs/guides/backpressure.md. I found a few sample snippets that are out-of-sync with SDK 0.9. Please help review.
jia: Thanks — can you point to the exact snippets? I can fix or add a migration note.
ashley: Near the top we have `client.requestOptions({max_concurrency: 16})` — that param was renamed to `concurrency_limit` in 0.9. We also reference an explicit `429_retry` flag which is now handled automatically by the runtime fallback.
sam: I'll open a tiny PR to update the sample and add a short migration table mapping old -> new names.
mike: +1. Also let's add a sentence about tradeoffs: larger batches reduce cost but can increase tail latency under backpressure. Saw a customer flip batch_window and see bigger p99s.
jia: Drafted a snippet that shows both old and new API usage and a one-line migration tip. Pasting the diff here:
```diff
- client.config({max_concurrency: 16})
+ client.config({concurrency_limit: 16})
```
olivia: Can we also add a tiny integration example in examples/ that runs the SDK snippet against a mock server? That'll catch regressions when we change params.
ashley: Yes. @doc-bot can you add a docs-qa checklist to the PR: 1) sample compiles and lints, 2) links valid, 3) migration note present, 4) small example tests run.
doc-bot: checklist added to PR #528 — items: samples-run, links-verified, migration-note, example-ci
sam: I'll own sample compile + CI. jia — can you take the migration note copy and the short paragraph about runtime fallbacks?
jia: On it. I'll also add a concise section "If you start seeing more 429s after upgrading" with three actionable fixes: tune `concurrency_limit`, enable prefix/KV cache, and add exponential backoff with jitter in your client calls.
mike: Suggest we include a simple reproduction command for staging to help triage noisy 429s: `ab -n 1000 -c 50 https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate` — put under a "how to repro in staging" note.
olivia: Quick docs reviewer checklist suggestion: add a "what changed" box at the top for users upgrading from SDK <0.9. Saves customers time.
ashley: Good idea. Let's also add a one-line compatibility matrix: SDK param -> runtime behavior. Keeps the handbook compact.
sam: Target: ship the docs PR by EOD Thursday and add a short slot in the Thurs docs sync to review. I'll post a reminder in #docs on Thursday morning. :calendar:
jia: I'll aim to have the migration copy + 429 troubleshooting blob by Wednesday EOD so Sam has time to add examples.
ashley: Thank you all. After merge, let's backport the migration note to the 0.8-era troubleshooting page so customers on older versions see it.
doc-bot: noted for backporting — creating backport issue after merge. :white_check_mark:
